root_cause: Linux proc_pid_cmdline_read returns ESRCH when get_proc_task cannot find a task that exited after procfs directory enumeration/open; the scanner accepted only NotFound and failed valid restore verification.
observed_error: cannot inspect process 685537: No such process (os error 3)
change: Only vanished procfs entries (ENOENT/NotFound or ESRCH) are skipped. Same-user permission and other I/O errors still fail; live worker command and retained process-group checks remain.

focused_kernel_regression.scope: Exact unchanged function/test bodies extracted from edited production module; this focused kernel regression does not replace full-crate validation.
focused_kernel_regression.primary_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/torvalds/linux/v6.18/fs/proc/base.c; proc_pid_cmdline_read returns -ESRCH after get_proc_task loses the exited task

focused_kernel_tests.real_kernel_race: Open own child cmdline, terminate/reap it, then read its still-open procfs file: ESRCH is accepted; reading its removed path yields ENOENT.
focused_kernel_tests.negative_controls: EPERM/EACCES/EIO/ENOTDIR still reject; existing command bytes remain unchanged.

full_fixed_suite: Pending actual integrated release validation; no fixed full-suite success claimed.
